title: Which of a regional air research centre's 36 low-cost ozone nodes go on the pull list for recalibration at the June 2028 round, judged on each node's span over the eight weeks to 31 May against the regional network's four reference analysers, beside each node's data capture in its first winter quarter and the analysers' 2027 days over the ozone target value
subdomain: sensor-calibration-measurement (low-cost gas-sensitive semiconductor ozone nodes read remotely against UV-photometric reference analysers kilometres away: span drift against a band, data capture, the EU maximum daily 8-hour mean)
prompt_shape: 10: a scorecard of the 36 nodes against the span band (the list, each listed node's direction, a chart of every node's span against the band), beside each node's hours with an accepted reading in November 2027 to January 2028 and each analyser's 2027 days over 120 micrograms

sources.origin: generated by task249/generator/make.py (seeded, deterministic) around a fictional regional air research centre in the Spanish interior: a regional ozone field shared by the comarca's background sites with local hour-to-hour departures that decorrelate with distance, 36 low-cost nodes whose heads drift in span and zero, the regional network's four reference analysers and their releases, the node export with its status codes, firmware change, link drops and a spare unit, the documents and the request; the centre, its sites, the contractor, the vendor, the network's stations and every person are invented, the EU ozone target value method and the low-cost sensor practice are real, and no real dataset is reproduced.
